ACCOUNT_PENDING: Your account is waiting for an admin to approve it.
ADMIN_REQUIRED: Only an admin can do that.
API_TOKEN_FAILED: Couldn’t make an API token. Try again.
EMAIL_LINKED_ELSEWHERE: This email is already linked to a different sign-in account.
LAST_ADMIN: Someone has to stay an admin. Make another person an admin first.
MAGIC_CODE_INVALID: This sign-in code has run out or was used already.
OWN_ADMIN_STATUS: You can’t change whether you’re an admin yourself.
PASSWORD_CHANGE_UNAVAILABLE: You sign in with a provider, so change your password there.
PASSWORD_SIGN_IN_DISABLED: Email and password sign-in is turned off. Sign in with {provider}.
PASSWORD_SIGN_UP_DISABLED: Email and password sign-up is turned off. Sign up with {provider}.
PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Choose a new password that’s different from the current one.
PROFILE_IMAGE_REMOVE_FAILED: Couldn’t remove your photo. Try again.
PROFILE_IMAGE_TYPE: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture.
PROFILE_IMAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED: Couldn’t upload your photo. Try again.
PROFILE_UPDATE_FAILED: Couldn’t save your profile. Try again.
REGISTRATION_DISABLED: Sign-up is closed. Ask an admin to add you.
REGISTRATION_MODE_LOCKED: Sign-up is set on the server (USER_SIGNUP), so it can’t be changed here.
SESSION_NOT_FOUND: That device is already signed out.
TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many tries. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
USER_EXISTS: There’s already an account with that email.
USER_NOT_FOUND: No one here has that email.
USER_NOT_PENDING: This person isn’t waiting for approval any more.
LAST_PASSKEY: Turn password sign-in back on before removing your last passkey.
PASSKEY_NEEDED: Add a passkey before turning password sign-in off.
PASSKEY_ONLY: This account signs in with a passkey.
PASSKEY_ORIGIN_UNKNOWN: Passkeys don’t work at this address. Open Anchor+ at its usual address.
PASSKEY_SIGN_IN_FAILED: Couldn’t sign in with that passkey.
PASSKEY_TIMEOUT: That took too long. Try again.
PASSKEY_UNKNOWN: That passkey isn’t known here. It may have been removed.
SECOND_FACTOR_REQUIRED: Your admin asks everyone to sign in with a passkey or an authenticator app. Set one up to carry on.
SIGN_IN_WITH_PASSKEY: A password alone no longer signs you in. Sign in with your passkey.
SIGN_IN_WITH_PROVIDER: A password alone no longer signs you in. Sign in with your sign-in provider.
TWO_STEP_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
TWO_STEP_SETUP_EXPIRED: The setup has run out. Start it again to get a new QR code.
OIDC_ACCOUNT: This account signs in with a sign-in provider.
OIDC_ALREADY_LINKED: Your account is already connected to a different sign-in account.
OIDC_CLAIMS_MISSING: The sign-in provider didn’t send an email address and ID.
OIDC_EMAIL_INVALID: The sign-in provider sent an email address that isn’t valid.
OIDC_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: There’s already an account with this email, and your sign-in provider hasn’t confirmed the email, so it can’t be linked.
OIDC_IDENTITY_TAKEN: That sign-in account is already connected to someone else here.
OIDC_ISSUER_INVALID: Enter a full issuer URL, like https://id.example.com.
OIDC_LOGIN_CODE_INVALID: That sign-in has run out. Sign in again.
OIDC_MISCONFIGURED: Single sign-on isn’t set up right. Check its settings.
OIDC_PROVIDER_ERROR: The sign-in provider turned the sign-in down.
OIDC_PROVIDER_EXISTS: There’s already a provider with the ID “{id}”.
OIDC_PROVIDER_ID_INVALID: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes for the ID, up to 32 of them, and not “{reserved}”.
OIDC_PROVIDER_LOCKED: This provider is set on the server. Change it there.
OIDC_PROVIDER_PRIMARY: The first provider is changed in the single sign-on settings.
OIDC_SETTINGS_LOCKED: Single sign-on is set on the server. Remove OIDC_ENABLED, OIDC_ISSUER_URL and OIDC_CLIENT_ID there to set it up here.
OIDC_SIGN_IN_FAILED: Couldn’t sign in with the provider. Try again.
OIDC_STATE_INVALID: That sign-in has run out. Sign in again.
OIDC_TOKEN_INVALID: That sign-in has run out. Sign in again.
CANNOT_SHARE_WITH_SELF: You can’t share a note with yourself.
LOCK_PATTERN_INVALID: A pattern joins at least 4 dots.
LOCK_SECRET_WRONG: {kind, select, pin {Wrong PIN or password.} other {Wrong pattern or password.}}
NOT_NOTE_OWNER: Only the note’s owner can do that.
NOTE_FROZEN: This note is frozen. Unfreeze it first.
NOTE_NOT_ACTIVE: Only notes that aren’t in the trash can be changed.
NOTE_NOT_FOUND: This note doesn’t exist any more.
NOTE_NOT_IN_TRASH: This note isn’t in the trash.
REVISION_NOT_FOUND: That version of the note doesn’t exist any more.
SHARE_LINK_NOT_FOUND: This link doesn’t open a note.
SHARE_LINK_VIEW_ONLY: This link can only view the note.
SHARE_NOT_FOUND: This note isn’t shared with that person any more.
VIEWER_CANNOT_EDIT: You can view this note but not change it.
ATTACHMENT_FILE_MISSING: The file is missing on the server.
ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND: That attachment doesn’t exist any more.
ATTACHMENT_NOT_YOURS: You can only delete attachments you added.
ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_FAILED: Couldn’t upload the file. Try again.
FILE_TOO_LARGE: That file is bigger than {maxMb} MB.
STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your storage is full. Delete pictures or files to add more.
TAG_NAME_EXISTS: There’s already a tag with that name.
TAG_NOT_FOUND: That tag doesn’t exist any more.
